title: Website product videos use the full gallery
summary: The storefront now keeps a large square media stage for both videos and photos.

changes.detail: Use the photo gallery square aspect ratio for video, including before metadata loads, instead of shrinking to a landscape frame.
Removed metadata-driven gallery resizing and unused dimension state; video content still uses contain fitting.
Updated existing gallery navigation regression coverage to require stable square sizing.
